entities.name: José Pamplona
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José Pamplona Lecuanda was a Mexican basketball player. He competed in the 1936 Summer Olympics. Born in San Luis Potosí, Pamplona was part of the Mexican basketball team that won the bronze medal. He played in one match.
